# Robust_NLME

## This repo contains R code that was used for the real data analysis and simulations in my paper \`\`Jointly Modeling Means and Variances for Nonlinear Mixed Effects Models with Measurement Errors and Outliers’’

------------------------------------------------------------------------

### What’s in the repo

> `/R`: source code
>
> - `Rnlme.R`: the function which jointly models mean and variance for
>   NLME. Measurement error model can be added if needed.
> - `Rnlme_methods.R`: Various S3 functions for the Rnlme class such as
>   Summary, VarCorr, etc,..
> - `get_Jloglike.R`, `est_fixed.R`, etc: all the other R files are
>   self-defined functions sourced in the above functions and main
>   analysis.
>
> `/inst/extdata`:

- `toy_data.rds`: A toy data generated from simulation to illustrate how
  to use our methods.

### [Example: apply the proposed methods to the toy data](https://aannaluo.github.io/JMVN/articles/Rnlme_Tutorial.html)

# Package index

## All functions

- [`Rnlme()`](https://aaannaluo.github.io/JMVN/reference/Rnlme.md) :
  Joint nonlinear mixed-effects model estimation (Rnlme)
- [`get_Jloglike()`](https://aaannaluo.github.io/JMVN/reference/get_Jloglike.md)
  : Construct joint log-likelihood structure from multiple NLME models
- [`get_info_sigma()`](https://aaannaluo.github.io/JMVN/reference/get_info_sigma.md)
  : Construct Sigma model information
- [`get_nlme_loglike()`](https://aaannaluo.github.io/JMVN/reference/get_nlme_loglike.md)
  : Build NLME log-likelihood components
- [`get_sd()`](https://aaannaluo.github.io/JMVN/reference/get_sd.md) :
  Standard error estimation for NLME parameters
